name: Lookup
description: Bound lookup/picker input with a search icon (opens a picker via whenclick) and an optional clear icon (icons.notempty, clears the bound field plus related fields via mergedataset). Inside a grid row it adds resolveprops/rowindex/includerefdata.

bind.description: Field holding the displayed description, e.g. "ALLOC_AC_DESC".

icon.description: Usually "search", opens the lookup popup via whenclick (add a whenclick action array to actually open it, e.g. filldataset into a popupinfo dataset).

icons.notempty.whenclick.description: Action array (mergedataset) that clears the bound field AND any related fields (e.g. the _DOCNO key field alongside the _DESC display field).
